review.verdict: Kicked a Dark Mending, ten Lava Bomb fire hits
review.summary: Seventh on Gehennas. One of the two Dark Mending kicks on Sulfuron. Ten Lava Bomb fire hits on Magmadar.

review.verdict: Third on Golemagg, which was the whole highlight
review.summary: Third on Golemagg with 1197/s, and a fair seventh on Sulfuron and eighth on Ragnaros. The rest: 18th on Lucifron, 18th on Majordomo, 13th on Geddon. Nine Lava Bomb fire hits on Magmadar, where you managed ninth on damage while standing in the fire. A warrior, in Molten Core, with the most consistent result of the night being the lava.
